title: Redis 4.x Unauthenticated RCE via Master-Slave Replication
description: Redis 4.0.14 listening without authentication: anyone can make it a replica of a rogue master, which sends a malicious module as the replication payload, then load that module to run commands.
question: Abuse the unauthenticated Redis 4.0.14 to run a command on the server.
